concepts.name: Components
concepts.description: A function taking props and returning a description of UI — not a template and not an object.

concepts.name: JSX
concepts.description: Syntax sugar over createElement calls; it produces data, not DOM.

concepts.name: Props
concepts.description: Read-only inputs flowing down; mutating them breaks the model.

concepts.name: State
concepts.description: Values a component owns, whose change triggers a re-render.

concepts.name: Lists and keys
concepts.description: Keys give list children a stable identity across renders; index keys quietly break on reorder.

concepts.name: Rules of hooks
concepts.description: Hooks are matched to state by call order, which is why they cannot be conditional.

concepts.name: useState
concepts.description: Declaring state, and why updates are queued rather than applied immediately.

concepts.name: useEffect
concepts.description: Synchronizing with something outside React — not a lifecycle callback.

concepts.name: Controlled inputs
concepts.description: Form values driven by state, with React as the single source of truth.

concepts.name: Lifting state up
concepts.description: Moving shared state to the nearest common ancestor instead of syncing two copies.

concepts.name: Render and commit model
concepts.description: Render is a pure computation; commit applies the diff. Confusing the two explains most surprising bugs.

concepts.name: useEffect dependencies
concepts.description: The dependency array is a correctness contract, not a performance knob.

concepts.name: useEffect cleanup
concepts.description: Returning a teardown to cancel subscriptions and in-flight work before the next effect run.

concepts.name: Context
concepts.description: Passing values past intermediate components — and the re-render cost of doing it carelessly.

concepts.name: useMemo and useCallback
concepts.description: Stabilizing values and identities; usually a fix for referential equality, not for slow code.

concepts.name: Stale closures
concepts.description: A callback capturing an old render's variables — the classic source of 'my state is one step behind'.

concepts.name: Reconciliation
concepts.description: How React decides to update, move or remount a node, and how component identity is determined.

concepts.name: Async race conditions
concepts.description: Out-of-order responses overwriting newer data, and why cleanup or an abort signal is the fix.
